To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the permittivity and the moisture content of oil free pressboard can be correlated and the moisture content in the pressboard can be measured by the capacitive sensor.
the moisture content of pressboard can be measured by dielectrometry and the moisture content can be calculated with universal expression.
a universal expression relating permittance and moisture concentration is developed to calculate on-line moisture content of oil free pressboard.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the moisture diffusion in transformer pressboard and the dielectric properties and the moisture concentration of pressboard can be measured with a single frequency method.
the measurement of dielectric permittivity of oil-free press-board and the relationship between moisture content and dielectric permittiv-ity.
a novel method to measure moisture of pressboard and the method is based on the relationship between dielectric properties and moisture content.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a single-frequency dielectric method is an effective method to monitor and estimate the moisture content in oil-free pressboard.
the dielectrometry method is a promising method for the measurement of the moisture concentration in transformer pressboard.
the proposed method is a reliable, accurate, non-destructive, real-time, on-line measurement method of moisture content in oil-free transformer pressboard.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the moisture content of pressboard can be nondestructively measured by the dielectric properties, the permittivity and loss tangent of pressboard can accurately be measured by capacitive sensor and the relationship between the dielectric properties and the moisture content can be accurately obtained by fitting the experimental data.
the moisture measurement method of transformer pressboard based on dielectric properties has been developed and the measurement of the moisture profile in the pressboard has been achieved.

a method for measuring the moisture content of pressboard is proposed, the effects of frequency and temperatures on signal are analyzed and a universal expression is developed to calculate moisture content in the oil-free pressboard.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the dielectric response can be used as a non-destructive technique to measure the moisture content in transformer pressboard and the dielectric response is sensitive to moisture concentration.
moisture content of oil free pressboard can be measured with single frequency method, and the measurement results can be used to monitor and control moisture diffusion process.
the permittivity and dielectric loss are the key parameters to determine moisture concentration in pressboard.
